note: The heading vocabulary §6.3 names specifically — 'Areas of Interest', 'Position of Responsibility' — plus the rest of what actually appears on Indian campus resumes. This set exists to keep the lexicon honest: it is the one most likely to regress when somebody adds a heading variant and forgets the neighbouring ones.

resumes.note: 'Position of Responsibility' and 'Areas of Interest' — both named in the spec, both absent from the first lexicon this set was run against. POR is annotated as `experience` rather than `extras`: it is a role with a title, a duration and a team, and `extras` is not a claim-bearing section — so filed there it produced no claim and no probe at all.
text: - Led a team of 12 volunteers across three events.

resumes.note: 'Relevant Coursework' and 'Scholastic Achievements' — the two most common variants after the obvious ones.
text: Vellore Institute of Technology, B.Tech ECE, 2022 - 2026, CGPA 8.9
- Awarded the merit scholarship for the top 1% of the 2022 intake.
- Simulated a 5G beamforming array in MATLAB and Simulink over 400 trials.
- Wrote a fixed-point FFT in C++ that runs 3x faster than the float version.

resumes.note: 'Industrial Training' and 'Co-curricular Activities'. Training is experience; co-curricular is extras, and the two are easy to swap.
text: - Trainee at BHEL Tiruchirappalli, Jun 2024 - Jul 2024.
- Studied the control loop of a 210 MW boiler feed pump.
- Built a line-following robot in Embedded C on an Arduino, finishing a 12m course in 40s.
- Member of the IEEE student branch, 2022 onwards.

resumes.note: 'Personal Details' and 'Declaration' — the block at the foot of a very traditional Indian resume. Declaration is not a section anyone should test on; it must not be mistaken for experience.
text: To work in a finance operations role in a growing organisation.
- Accounts Assistant, Sundaram Traders, Aug 2023 - Present.
- Reconciled 300 vendor invoices a month in Tally.
I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge.
